events.title: FIESTA RAVE
events.description:
FIESTA RAVE returns to Tulum Detroit with special guest BONES (CDMX), official DJ for Tito Double P, alongside Detroit’s own SWDEJAY.

Bringing Mexico City’s underground energy to Southwest Detroit with Reggaeton, Latin House, Guaracha, Afro House, Ghetto Tech, Dembow & Corridos.

Expect high-energy sets, tropical vibes, drinks by El Jimador and food by Taqueria El Rey.
